value.rationale: The equal-singular-value column-orthogonal family is a natural optimally conditioned benchmark, so the nonconvergence is an inconsistency effect rather than conditioning. The complete neutral-to-attracting orbit bifurcation identifies an error floor and a quadratic-convergence-to-wrong-limit trap, while adjacent averaging provably removes the false two-cycle in this precise model. This explains a nontrivial limitation of unextended residual projections and distinguishes their use from extended least-squares corrections; it is not merely a one-step negative check.
